meta.description: A website built around your Lockii booking widget, for self-service rentals.

hero.heading: A website that books your Lockii rentals
hero.lead: Lockii runs your rentals without staff. We build the website that gets them found and booked, with your Lockii booking built in from day one, for rental businesses anywhere.

image.slot: Your picture goes here: the fleet, or a phone with a Lockii booking open. Landscape, at least 1600 pixels wide.

why.heading: Your website does the job your staff would
why.body: Nobody answers the phone at an unstaffed rental, so the site has to explain how pickup works, whether a hitch is needed and what the deposit covers. Customers search for a trailer or a kayak when they need one, usually on a phone, and the site has to show up for that search and reach your booking in two taps. Lockii takes the booking, the ID check and the payment. A clear, fast site around it is what gets someone to start.
